name: Oudou Tsuguhiko
source:
A young man who loves eroge, knows everything about sex, and is aiming to become a scenario writer. After meeting one of his former underlings, the demon Bezel, he learned that he was the reincarnation of the Demon King. Ever since then, he kept himself chaste, a condition of his reawakening, by limiting his desires solely to denizens of the second dimension. Though he waited for the day when he would regain his power and could reshape the world to his liking, he was ultimately betrayed by Bezel, who took those powers for himself.

When it comes to sex, he is easily excited by his own imagination, but far more so by the actual act itself. He knows where his values lie; he is by no means submissive, but nor does he disregard the other party’s wishes. While overly self-conscious, his manner of speech can come off as a little cringy.
